name: det_tiny_v3_qat
description: Model family 'tiny' text-line detector: DBNet-lite on MobileNetV4-small 0.5 (det_v2's architecture, 350k params, 1.57 G MACs), det_v2 fine-tuned on pages_v2 / pages_v3o / pages_v5 (photo-style v5 pages: name cards, lyric videos, anime screens, pages photographed off a screen, avatars and captions as negatives) 25/25/50%, then detector QAT; int8 via ESP-PPQ PTQ, .hxhm v2 (raw output), bit-exact with ESP-PPQ (host, wasm SIMD, wasm scalar). Input 640x640 letterbox (long side to 640, top-left, pad 255); output [2,320,320] int8.
tuning: browser pipeline, int8, reading confidence 0.8: see docs/research/JOURNAL.md (2026-11-25, model family) and experiments/family/eval
min_conf_note: page lines whose mean character confidence is below this are hidden as probably not Hunter script (web/test/page_e2e.mjs --conf-sweep)
min_show_score_note: page lines whose detector score (mean text-kernel probability) is below this are hidden too (web/test/page_e2e.mjs --score-sweep)
